tasks.title: Cargo.toml: Add rusqlite dependency
tasks.description: Update Cargo.toml to add the `rusqlite` crate with the `bundled` feature, enabling SQLite to be compiled in without a system SQLite requirement. The `cargo init` setup command has already created the base Cargo.toml.

tasks.title: Storage: Types — Bookmark & StorageError
tasks.description: Define the `Bookmark` struct (id, url, desc, tags, created_at) and the `StorageError` enum (Open, InvalidInput, Duplicate, NotFound, Db variants) in `src/storage.rs`. These types are the foundation for all storage operations.

tasks.title: Storage: Initialize Database
tasks.description: Implement the `init_db(db_path: &str) -> Result<Connection, StorageError>` function in `src/storage.rs`. Opens or creates the SQLite file and runs `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` for the bookmarks schema.

tasks.title: Storage: Add Bookmark
tasks.description: Implement `add_bookmark(conn: &Connection, url: &str, desc: &str, tags: &str) -> Result<i64, StorageError>` in `src/storage.rs`. Validates non-empty URL, inserts the row, and maps SQLite UNIQUE constraint violations to `StorageError::Duplicate` and other DB errors to `StorageError::Db`.

tasks.title: Storage: Search Bookmarks
tasks.description: Implement `search_bookmarks(conn: &Connection, query: &str) -> Result<Vec<Bookmark>, StorageError>` in `src/storage.rs`. Returns all rows ordered by `created_at DESC` when query is empty; otherwise filters via SQLite LIKE across url, desc, and tags (case-insensitive ASCII, relying on SQLite default LIKE behaviour).

tasks.title: Storage: Remove Bookmark
tasks.description: Implement `remove_bookmark(conn: &Connection, id: i64) -> Result<(), StorageError>` in `src/storage.rs`. Executes DELETE and returns `StorageError::NotFound(id)` if no rows were affected, or `StorageError::Db` for other failures.

tasks.title: Storage: Unit Tests
tasks.description: Add a `#[cfg(test)]` module inside `src/storage.rs` covering: database creation, add+search round-trip, empty-query returns all rows, non-empty query filters correctly, duplicate URL returns StorageError::Duplicate, and remove with unknown id returns StorageError::NotFound.
